page: UpCloud GPU-48xCPU-960GB-4xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 physical cores powered by Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processors running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 960.0 GB of system memory, providing 20.0 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, delivering a combined 320 GB of VRAM. This configuration does not include local storage.

Benchmark results highlight top-tier capabilities in multi-threaded decompression and memory bandwidth. The server achieved a bzip3 multi-threaded decompression rate of 615.79 GB/sec and a small-block read-only memory bandwidth of 7649.82 GB/sec. Large-block read and write memory bandwidths reached 316.04 GB/sec and 135.84 GB/sec, respectively. For language model workloads, prompt processing for a small 135M model reached 10308.98 tokens/sec, while text generation achieved 377.14 tokens/sec. Multi-core CPU performance is strong, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 96293.69 and a PassMark CPU score of 85426.66.

Given the high density of GPU and memory resources, this server represents a specialized hardware class designed for resource-intensive workloads. The absence of local storage requires external storage integration, which is a key architectural tradeoff. The platform is highly suited for large-scale artificial intelligence tasks, including LLM inference, deep learning training, complex scientific simulations, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
